notes.title: Thank You, Soundtrack Release and The Future
notes.notes:
[h1]Thank You[/h1]

Thank you to all players who have purchased Fabrication.

On January 6th 2021, Fabrication recouped it's development cost just 26 days after release at 11th December 2020. Thanks to all who bought the game. :)

I told myself that sales isn't really the reason I made this game, but the fact that it recouped it's cost and is now turning a profit has made it worth the years I have spent on this project.

I have also received feedback from the United States players, saying that there are impressed and happy with the game. Thank you!
I will be releasing the Fabrication soundtrack sometime in 2021, this will be a free DLC.

There's also a long-awaited update that released to White Pearl... the quest journal, that released on January 29th. I'm sorry it took years to add this to White Pearl (laughs). Thanks to all 25k players of White Pearl for their support and feedback on this experiment.

[b]Regarding further feedback[/b]

If you wish to leave feedback for the game, please do so in a game review. 

[b]Regarding game updates[/b]

White Pearl was lucky enough to receive multiple major updates and patches throughout it's lifetime, along with the last major update, 2.10: The Quest Journal Patch, releasing on 29th January 2021.

Because of reduced player response and a lack of personal time, Fabrication will have no major updates, only bug fixes patches sporadically. 

[b]Regarding possible future titles[/b]

There are currently no plans to develop another game in the Chronicles of Ottrea series.

[h1]Fabrication - Soundtrack
[/h1]
The Fabrication soundtrack will be released sometime in 2021.

This will be a free DLC that is automatically added when you purchase/download the game.

notes.title: Fabrication - Set to Release at 11th December 2020!
notes.notes:
Hello there!

This is Harry, the developer of the game.

After I released White Pearl, my first ever game project and RPG Maker game, it was received with so much support and feedback. Of course, even with this much acclaim, I understood that some people didn't like the game and thought it could be better and personally I had a desire to improve and be better. With Fabrication, I wanted to make a game that first and foremost - was developed with the criticism of White Pearl in mind. I made a conscious effort to improve as a developer while making this game and I am very pleased with the results. 

Although the store page does explain most of what the game about, if you do not wish to wait, why not try out White Pearl? White Pearl is a free game that can give you an idea on what my previous work was like, and with Fabrication I hope to impress both fans of that game and first-timers who are just looking in!

As of the time of writing, just 5 weeks before release of the game, I am developing the ending and final boss of this game while going through the final stage of debugging and player feedback. Actually, I didn't plan to release this game until January but I couldn't pass up the holiday season! [i](laughs)[/i] 

I am just very excited. Thank you to all those who left a review on White Pearl who made this game possible.

I will be setting up the forums soon for bug reports, suggestions and everything like that, so hang tight and wait until you can get your hands on this game!

If you wish to learn more about the development and details of the game, [url=https://hgdb2.home.blog/2020/11/04/interview-developing-and-releasing-fabrication/]visit my main blog post celebrating the end of development of Fabrication[/url] (it's very strange to say that).

If you have questions or concerns, please visit [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/916210/discussions/0/2995417914179877235/]this thread[/url].
